title: LCLI-807 follow-ups: referenceKey in orphans, link dedupe and projection edges, fold-table test and generator nits
description:
Follow-up carried from the #749/#750 Opus verdict (recorded on LCLI-807). Done inside lore's slack before LBUMP, with a Sonnet review; does not gate LBUMP unless ready.
- #749 SF1: src/core/orphans.ts around :262, :276, :286-288 classifies by referenceKey over id plus aliases, and both new orphans tests assert orphanTasks: [] (red today).
- #749 SF2: link.ts containsCaseInsensitive (~:1095) and dedupeTaskIds (~:1069), and projection.ts ~:206-213 edges, all by referenceKey.
- #750 SF2: rename the tautological 'agrees with the library at EVERY code point' test as self-consistency and drop the drift-protection claim.
- Generator nit 2: --lib checked against a pinned sha256, and --ts comparing the whole module.
- The comment nits, plus one CHANGELOG line for the fold change.
- Until quest has its pin, reword the three 'fails in whichever half lags' comments to say only lore's half is pinned.
#750 SF1 (quest's missing case-fold digest pin) is a pair item routed to quest-cli, not here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: orphans, link dedupe/contains and projection edges classify by referenceKey, each with a test red without the fix
The tautological every-code-point test is renamed as self-consistency and no longer claims drift protection
The generator checks --lib against a pinned sha256 and --ts compares the whole module
The three whichever-half-lags comments say only lore half is pinned; one CHANGELOG line covers the fold change

implementationNotes:
REQUEST CHANGES at 33fd6544 (opum-ai/lore-cli#756, LCLI-809). The PR leaves two places where task references are compared two different ways, and both cause wrong behaviour that did not happen before it.

How this was checked: by reading the code only. I had no shell, so I ran no tests, no mutants, no generator and no `git diff`. Every red or green result below is traced by hand. The list of changed files is your account, not something I listed myself.

BLOCKERS

B1. `lore check` and `lore sync` can now crash when two concepts link the same task with differently spelled ids. This PR caused it.
- `dedupeTaskIds` now matches by referenceKey (link.ts:1065-1076).
- The reconcile maps still match by `toLowerCase`:
  - `resolveRollupDetails` (reconcile-shared.ts:270, 277, 281)
  - `resolveTaskDetails` (:328, 330, 333)
  - `pickResolved` (:357, 364)
  - the per-concept lookup (:230)
- Example: concept A lists `STRASSE` and concept B lists `straße` (or the same id in NFC and NFD form).
  - :221 deduplicates them down to `STRASSE`, so `details` only holds the key `strasse`.
  - For concept B, :230 calls `details.get("straße")`, which returns undefined. The `as RollupDetail` cast hides that, and `d.status` throws a TypeError.
- The pooled path in check.ts:1073 fails too. The pool keeps one spelling and a root's own `pickResolved` (reconcile-shared.ts:223) asks for the other, so it throws "internal: task … was never resolved".
- Before this PR, deduplication and the map keys both used toLowerCase, so both spellings were kept and resolved.
- Fix: key all four reconcile-shared sites by referenceKey. Then change orphans.ts:333 `resolutions.get(spelling.toLowerCase())` to match. Add a two-concept test using `STRASSE` and `straße`. No test in this PR reaches this path.

B2. `lore unlink` reports a removal it never writes to the doc (link.ts:445-449).
- :445 decides `removed` with `containsTaskReference`, which folds.
- :448-449 build the list to remove and filter the frontmatter with `toLowerCase`.
- Example: the stored entry is `straße` and the user runs `lore unlink <c> STRASSE`.
  - The task is reported `removed`.
  - The removal set is {"strasse"}, but `"straße".toLowerCase()` is `"straße"`, so the entry stays in `tasks:`.
  - `changed` is false, yet `removeBackRefs` (:476) still strips the tracker's `doc:` label.
- Result: the doc still links the task, the tracker no longer points back, and the report says removed. Before this PR both checks said `not-linked`.
- This is also a direct failure of check 1: a task-reference comparison is still on toLowerCase in src/.
- No test covers `containsTaskReference`, so a mutant reverting it would stay green. Add an unlink fold test and an already-linked fold test.

SHOULD-FIX

S1. Check 3, the `referenced.add` mutant.
- `"STRASSE".toLowerCase()` and `referenceKey("STRASSE")` are the same string (`strasse`). So any test that spells the *reference* `STRASSE` against an id `straße` only tests the task-id side.
- With orphans.ts:263 reverted to toLowerCase, the LCLI-809 test at orphans.test.ts:788-797 stays GREEN. The `STRASSE` key still matches the task's key, so `some()` hides the miss on the NFD reference, and `danglingLinks` does not read `referenced`.
- Only the NFD-alias test at :799-807 goes red. I checked by grep that line 800 holds a real U+0301 and the alias at :802 does not.
- The other three mutants do go red, each because the spelling differs under lower() and fold():
  - known-set: orphans.test.ts:788 (id `straße`)
  - dedupeTaskIds: lcli791-quest-rollup.test.ts:641-642
  - projection edge key: projection.test.ts:312/332-341
- Fix: in :788, spell a reference `straße` against an id `STRASSE` so the ß case tests the reference side too.

S2. The claim that decision refs "keep their own comparison" is only half true.
- Decision deduplication goes through `dedupeTaskIds` (link.ts:1192), which now folds.
- Membership still uses `containsCaseInsensitive` (:1196).
- The `dedupeTaskIds` docstring (:1051-1063) still says "case-insensitively" and says it serves both fields.
- It makes no practical difference for ASCII `<repo>:DEC-N`, but either give decisions their own dedupe or correct the claim and the docstring.

S3. Check 2: aliases are not handled everywhere.
- orphans indexes id plus aliases (orphans.ts:271, 292, 461-463). The re-keyed confirmation read is correct:
  - `suspects` is keyed by fold.
  - Each spelling is looked up with the same `toLowerCase` that `resolveTaskDetails` stored it under.
  - An id and alias that fold to the same key only duplicate a set entry, which is harmless.
- projection.ts:105-107 indexes only `task.id`. A `tasks:` entry or dependency naming an alias projects as `dangling: true`, while orphans now calls it live.
- `containsTaskReference` (link.ts:1099) compares only against stored `tasks:` strings, never against the resolved detail's aliases. Linking `LCLI-5` when the doc already lists its alias `OLD-1` reports `added` and stores a duplicate.
- Collisions: two tasks that fold to one key overwrite each other in orphans `byId` (:271, last one wins for the parent walk). In projection `taskKeys` (:107) both task records end up with the same `key`. This already happened with toLowerCase; the fold now catches more ids.
- Either fix these or file them as explicit follow-ups. Don't leave them unstated.

NITS
- orphans.ts:254 ("case-insensitive known-id set") and :259 ("lower-cased task ids") describe the old behaviour.
- link.ts:1104: the `containsCaseInsensitive` docstring still says `tasks:` membership uses it.
- CHANGELOG.md:12 says "in every read path", but B1 shows the reconcile keying does not fold yet.
- link.ts:305 stores `t.task.toLowerCase()` in frontmatter, which depends on the engine. This is older than this PR.
- Sorting only, not identity: orphans.ts:466-469, workspace-projection.ts:204 and ladybug-source.ts:472 still sort by toLowerCase, while projection.ts:105 now sorts by fold.
- Projection task-record keys change for non-ASCII ids (projection.ts:107) with no `PROJECTION_NORMALIZATION_VERSION` bump. ASCII ids are unaffected.
- Not task references, fine as they are: labels (link.ts:538, 800, 1110), doc paths (:1120, 1129), concept ids (:1040), and query, schema and profile filters.

CHECK 4 (generator): passes.
- The sha256 pin is checked against the library file's bytes (gen-case-fold-table.mjs:61-68) before the map is parsed (:69-75).
- `--ts` compares the whole module byte for byte (:220) and fails if any byte differs (:225), so a header or formatting change cannot pass.
- The committed header (case-fold-table.ts:1-14) and tail (:68-80) match `formatModule` (:119-149) as far as reading can show.
- No test runs the script. The test-side mentions are comments at lcli791-quest-rollup.test.ts:492 and :510, so nothing needs network access at test time.
- Nit: usage line 40 says "then let biome format the file", but :220 needs exact bytes. If biome ever changes the file, a clean table fails `--ts`. That fails safe, but the wording disagrees with the code. Your report says a clean run was accepted; I could not re-run it.

CHECK 5 (test/helpers.ts:184): passes. Aliases are only copied into the summary when a fixture declares them, so fixtures without aliases build the same objects and their `toEqual` checks are unchanged. The only list-driven fixtures with aliases are the new orphans ones (orphans.test.ts:790, :802), and they need it.

CHECK 6 (sensitive paths): no hit that I could find. There is no `unicode-case-folding` in package.json, the lockfile or .github/. Closest calls:
- `scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs`: it is under scripts/, but it is a hand-run tool, not wired into CI or release.
- CHANGELOG.md, which the release-notes step reads.
I could not list the full diff to confirm nothing else was touched.

#756 round 1 verdict above: REQUEST CHANGES at 33fd6544 (file sha256 98da2e6f002e3aa3f30b9bc09617f7a9f80008f9a9cbacd7a8657d0b678777a2, 7838 bytes, recorded verbatim). Round 2 pushed at 1c35bea2: B1 (reconcile-shared keyed by referenceKey), B2 (unlink removal set), S1, S2 and the nits fixed; S3 and the projection normalization-version bump are deferred to the post-0.15.1 follow-up tasks filed with this note (leader ruling: B, defer, no released bundle has non-ASCII ids).

APPROVE at 1c35bea2 (opum-ai/lore-cli#756 round 2, LCLI-809). No blockers. One should-fix-or-rule item, a few nits, and the shell-only gaps are listed at the end. This is a read-only review: no mutant was executed, and git was not run.

B1, fixed. Every reconcile map is now keyed by referenceKey:
- resolveRollupDetails, reconcile-shared.ts:271/278/282
- resolveTaskDetails, :329/331/334
- pickResolved, :358/365
- the per-concept lookup, :231
At 33fd654 all of these were toLowerCase (:230/270/277/281/328/330/333/357/364). check.ts:1073-1076 sends the referenceKey-keyed map as detailsOverride, so check's multi-root path is consistent. orphans.ts:333 is now `resolutions.get(referenceKey(spelling))`; it was spelling.toLowerCase() at 33fd654. The test is reconcile-shared.test.ts:133: concept A has [STRASSE], concept B has [straße], and both resolve. At 33fd654, dedupe folded to [STRASSE], so B's details.get("straße") was undefined and `d.status` throws. That makes it red at 33fd654 by reading.

B2, fixed. In unlink, link.ts:450-451 builds removedKeys and filters existingTasks, both by referenceKey, matching containsTaskReference (:1115-1118, used at :302 and :445). Tests are at link.test.ts:214-234: link with STRASSE against stored straße gives already-linked, and unlink with STRASSE empties tasks:. Both tests use --no-back-ref, so the tracker-side removal isn't exercised. The frontmatter assertion is the defect B2 named, so that's acceptable.

Check 1, the remaining-site sweep. I grepped toLowerCase, toLocaleLowerCase, toUpperCase and localeCompare across src/.
- Task-reference comparison residue is link.ts:305 only, the storage site you ruled as a follow-up.
- Sort-only sites: orphans.ts:467-468 (compareLower), core/ladybug-source.ts:472, core/workspace-projection.ts:204. For information: projection.ts:105 now sorts by referenceKey, while those two core sites still sort by lowercase. That only changes order and is not a defect.
- Everything else is labels, doc paths, decision refs, concept ids or unrelated: link.ts:540/802/1042/1124/1147, tasks.ts:197 (status), orphans.ts:396 (labels).
- SHOULD-FIX OR RULE: core/query.ts:394 `equalsFold` is toLowerCase, and it backs `lore query`'s generic frontmatter key=value filter (:365/371/375). A query on the tasks key, such as tasks=STRASSE against stored straße, would not match. It's a generic query filter, not a tracker resolver, and it isn't on the ruled list. Either add it to the follow-up list or rule it out of scope.
- core/validate.ts has no `tasks` hits. adapters/quest.ts carries only doc mentions (:984/988).

Check 2, tests vs mutants. I reasoned these from the code; I did not run them.
- M1, referenced.add: killed by orphans.test.ts:777. The id is STRASSE and the reference is straße, so lower is "straße" and fold is "strasse"; the task becomes an orphan. S1 is satisfied.
- M2, the known-set: killed by orphans.test.ts:790 through the NFD café reference, where lower keeps NFD and the known key is NFC. viewTask returns null, so confirmation can't rescue it. Test :777 alone would not kill M2, because the confirmation read rescues it there.
- M3, dedupeTaskIds: killed by lcli791-quest-rollup.test.ts:639-642.
- M5, the reconcile maps: killed by reconcile-shared.test.ts:133, and on the taskRollup branch by lcli791:446-455, an NFD request read back with get(referenceKey(nfd)).
- M6, containsTaskReference: killed by link.test.ts:219.
- M7, the unlink removal set: killed by link.test.ts:226.
- M4, the projection edge key: I didn't trace it individually. projection.test.ts carries 8 straße/STRASSE uses, unchanged from round 1.
- Nit, a coverage gap: reconcile-shared.ts:271 is the failure path for the whole rollup read, and it has no non-ASCII test. If it were reverted to lower, pickResolved would throw "internal: never resolved" in place of the real cause, and nothing would go red.
- Nit: the B1 test runs only the per-task path, because fakeAdapter has no taskRollup. It's adequate because pickResolved and the :231 lookup are shared code.

Check 3, decisions. dedupeDecisionRefs (link.ts:1081-1092) is byte-equivalent in logic to the pre-PR dedupeTaskIds at review-746-98b5ad3 link.ts:1060-1071 (`ref.toLowerCase()`, first-seen kept). Its only caller is :1210, which is the same single decision call site the old code had at :1176. The docstring at :1075-1080 is corrected. No test pins the decision comparison against a non-ASCII repo qualifier. That's a nit and optional.

Check 4, the CHANGELOG (lines 17-18). The "Not yet alias-aware" sentence is present and accurate about projection and link membership. No PROJECTION_NORMALIZATION_VERSION bump is claimed; the constant is still "1" (projection.ts:47). The "every read path" wording is gone. The headline lists check, sync, link, unlink, tasks, orphans and projection, and I found each one true. Minor: rename (through dedupeTaskIds, rename.ts:227) also folds now and isn't named. That's an omission, not a false claim.

Check 5, the dev merge. This is proxy evidence only.
- Fold-site counts (LCLI-809, referenceKey or CASE_FOLD) went from 33fd654 to 1c35bea as follows: projection 8→8, quest.ts 6→6, case-fold-table 5→5, orphans 7→10, link 9→14, reconcile-shared 0→13. Nothing dropped.
- LCLI-792 mention counts in cli.ts, sync.ts, advisory-run.ts and advisory-lock.ts are identical (1/4/1/3) to review-746-98b5ad3. That commit is #746's review head, not 809fbb83, and none of those files contains referenceKey.
- To confirm properly: `git diff 809fbb83 1c35bea -- src/core/advisory-lock.ts src/commands/advisory-run.ts src/commands/sync.ts src/cli.ts` should be empty.

Check 6, DEC-182 (1). I couldn't enumerate the PR's file list. What I know is touched: src/commands/*, src/adapters/quest.ts, src/adapters/case-fold-table.ts, src/core/projection.ts, tests, CHANGELOG.md and scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs. The closest call is the script. Its line 25 says it isn't wired into CI or release, and no package.json, bun.lock or .github file references unicode-case-folding. On my reading it's not on the floor, but that judgement is yours.

Nits:
- reconcile-shared.ts:196 (@throws: "does not case-insensitively match") and :310 ("checked (case-insensitively)") are stale. Both now go through referenceKey via verifiedViewTask. They fall under your stale-comments ruling.
- The generator usage nit is addressed. The --write line at gen-case-fold-table.mjs:40-41 now says the output is biome-stable and must not be reformatted; at 33fd654 :40 it said "then let biome format the file". The usage error string at :183 is unchanged and correct.
- The S3 follow-ups (alias-aware projection and link, fold-key collisions): this head carries no new Quest record for them. LCLI-809.json is To Do with no notes. They may sit on a tracker-only branch; please confirm they're filed. Nothing in .quest claims the normalization bump was done.

Could not confirm without a shell:
- M1-M7 were not executed.
- The 543-pass figure wasn't reproduced.
- The PR file list wasn't enumerated.
- The 809fbb83→1c35bea byte-diff of the advisory-lock files wasn't run.
- The red-at-33fd654 claim for the B1 test is by code reading, not a run.

Round 2 landed: #756 squash c070227a (head 1c35bea2, merged with --match-head-commit; ubuntu went red once on the known epoll hang, exit 124, and passed on one rerun of the failed job). The round-2 verdict above is APPROVE at 1c35bea2 (file sha256 4790271d8f8ca505b38c66bd59f5835264ecd0e424fce3eec9a09fd4f84a4dd7, 7206 bytes, recorded verbatim). Version bump and S3 deferred to LCLI-811..816 (post-0.15.1); equalsFold, stale reconcile-shared comments and coverage gap, and the rename CHANGELOG naming are in the follow-up filed with this note. LCLI-807 AC1 (orphans) is now met in fact by #756.
